faq.question: Why are only certain tools featured right now?
faq.answer: The public site is intentionally curated. We are prioritizing tools that are broadly useful and easier to explain clearly before expanding the featured surface again.

faq.question: Do featured tools run in the browser?
faq.answer: Many featured conversion workflows run in the browser after the page loads. Site assets, analytics scripts, and advertising scripts may still load as part of the page.

faq.question: Can I rely on the result without checking it?
faq.answer: No. For high-stakes work, always verify important results independently. Featured pages are meant to be useful and clear, but not a substitute for professional review.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No. The current featured tools are available without account creation.

faq.question: Can I request improvements to a page?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the contact page to report unclear copy, calculation issues, missing examples, or requests for additional featured tools.

mortgageCalculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
mortgageCalculator.description: Calculate monthly mortgage payments, total interest, and amortization schedule with taxes, insurance, and PMI.

tips.title: Mortgage Tips
tips.tip1: A larger down payment reduces your monthly payment and eliminates PMI if 20% or more
tips.tip2: Consider the total cost of homeownership including taxes, insurance, and maintenance
tips.tip3: Shop around for the best interest rates - even 0.25% can save thousands
tips.tip4: Factor in closing costs, which typically range from 2-5% of the home price
tips.tip5: Consider a 15-year mortgage for faster payoff and less total interest
tips.tip6: Make extra principal payments to reduce the total interest paid over time

content.intro: Our comprehensive time and date tool collection serves developers, businesses, and individuals who need accurate time calculations and conversions. From Unix timestamp conversion to international timezone management, our tools handle complex time-related tasks with precision.
content.developerTools: Convert Unix timestamps (epoch time) to readable dates, handle API timestamps, debug time-related issues, and manage database date fields with our professional timestamp converter.
content.businessApplications: Calculate working days between project milestones, plan international meetings across timezones, and track deadlines with our business-focused date calculation tools.
content.globalOperations: Our timezone converter supports all world timezones with automatic daylight saving time adjustments. Perfect for international teams, global businesses, and remote work coordination.
content.personalProductivity: Use our countdown timers for events, calculate your exact age, track time with our stopwatch, and stay organized with world clock displays for multiple cities.
content.conclusion: All tools provide real-time accuracy, work offline after loading, and support multiple date formats. Essential for software development, project management, and international business.
